description: Recursively scan a directory for exposed secrets and API keys. Automatically skips node_modules, .git, dist, and binary files.

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file: only findings not in it are reported

entropy.description: Also flag random-looking values assigned to secret-like names (default true)

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings (e.g. [".env", ".ts"])

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

name: scan_directory
